source_identity.canonical_title: Les hommes qui accusent les féministes de les avoir poussés dans les bras de Trump n'étaient pas des alliés à la base

translation.canonical_title: Men who accuse feminists of driving them into Trump's arms were not allies to begin with
translation.displayed_title: Men who accuse feminists of driving them into Trump's arms were not allies to begin with
translation.summary: If people became Trump supporters because of feminists, it is simply because they saw their privileges threatened, those privileges being guaranteed by the violence and injustices permitted by patriarchy. If they prefer to preserve their superior position rather than grant women a humanity unjustly denied to them, then they were already women’s enemies.
